function.name: local_fauna

message.content:
Here are a few great picnic spots in Miami where you can relax, enjoy the scenery, and have a tasty meal: | Spot | Description | Highlights | |------|-------------|------------| | **South Pointe Park** | Located at the southern tip of Miami Beach, this park offers panoramic views of the ocean, cruise ships, and the Miami skyline. | • Picnic tables with ocean views
• Walking paths and a playground
• Nearby cafés for snacks | | **Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park** | A bit farther out on Key Biscayne, this state park has a historic lighthouse and a beautiful beach. | • Spacious picnic areas with grills
• Lighthouse tours
• Kayaking and paddleboarding | | **Lummus Park** | Right on Ocean Drive, this park is a favorite for locals and tourists alike. | • Picnic tables along the beach
• Volleyball courts
• Easy access to restaurants | | **Oleta River State Park** | The largest urban park in the U.S., it’s a bit inland but offers lush mangroves and a calm river. | • Picnic shelters and grills
• Canoe rentals
• Hiking trails | | **Miami Beach Boardwalk** | Stretching from South Beach to North Beach, the boardwalk is perfect for a scenic stroll before settling down. | • Picnic spots along the boardwalk
• Beach access
• Numerous food trucks nearby | **Tips for a Great Picnic in Miami:** - **Bring sunscreen and a hat** – the Florida sun can be intense. - **Check the weather forecast** – Miami can get humid and rainy, especially in summer. - **Reserve a spot if possible** – some parks allow you to reserve picnic tables online. - **Pack a cooler** – keep drinks cold and food fresh. - **Respect wildlife** – especially in parks like Oleta River; keep trash in your bag. Enjoy your picnic! If you need directions or more details about any of these spots, just let me know.
